title: Cozy Server Kit
description: Lightweight server utilities for small survival servers: land claims, death chests, homes/TPA, starter kits, and more.
body:
## Features
- Land claims (wand selection, trust, overlap protection, particle visualization)
- Death chest (no ground drops, right-click to restore original inventory slots, nearest ground on void death)
- Named homes (up to 5)
- TPA / TPAHERE with accept/deny
- `/csk back` after death (including void deaths)
- Starter kit on first join only
- Server rules on first join + `/csk rules`
- One-player sleep
- AFK tab prefix
- Death location marker (particles)
- Bulk break (shift + mine ores/trees, correct tool only)
- No natural mob spawn inside claims
- All features toggleable in `config/cozyserverkit-common.toml`

## Commands
- `/csk wand` — get claim wand
- `/csk claim` — create claim from wand selection
- `/csk unclaim` — remove claim you're standing in
- `/csk trust <player>` — trust player in your claim
- `/csk untrust <player>` — remove trust
- `/csk claims` — list your claims
- `/csk show` — show claim borders
- `/csk sethome <name>` — set named home
- `/csk home <name>` — teleport to home
- `/csk delhome <name>` — delete home
- `/csk homes` — list homes
- `/csk tpa <player>` — request teleport to player
- `/csk tpahere <player>` — request player to come to you
- `/csk tpaccept` — accept TPA request
- `/csk tpdeny` — deny TPA request
- `/csk back` — return to previous location
- `/csk rules` — show server rules
- `/csk starterkit` — give starter kit (admin)
